## Local-only original Koinly-format CSV structural preflight (100% FREE)
- Public new firstparty official-template structure QA tool: https://livastic-vm3-primary-tmp-260920.github.io/crypto-csv-rescue/koinly-preflight/ . Browser-only opt-in local FILE check with static same-origin scripts and strict CSP connect-src 'none'; no raw CSV upload, no wallet connection, no request/fee, no original source rows/identifying file names in output. Koinly Simple requires exactly `Koinly Date`, `Amount`, `Currency`; Trades requires exactly `Koinly Date`, `Pair`, `Side`, `Amount`, `Total`; Universal requires exactly `Date`, `Sent Amount`, `Sent Currency`, `Received Amount`, `Received Currency`. Validates schema, true UTC calendar dates, decimal signs, inconsistent rows, spreadsheet-formula-looking cells; no guessing fees, missing acquisition cost or exchange timezones. Input limit512KiB, 200 rows and36 columns. All in original one-owner source, no outside buyers/testimonials. A structural PASS does not mean a Koinly account accepted an import, tax calculation was done or blockchain settlement was verified; not endorsed or affiliated with Koinly.
- Original current official source reference https://support.koinly.io/en/articles/9489976-how-to-create-a-custom-csv-file-with-your-data and https://support.koinly.io/en/articles/9885319-how-to-modify-csv-files-to-import-them-to-koinly (UTC required).
